name: lte/get-started-metatrader
title: Get started: Metatrader (Link it to MetaTrader 4 or 5.)

f2.default: MetaTrader is where you’ll see the charts and place trades. You log in with the trading account Vantage created for you.

f5.default: Vantage emails your trading account number and server after setup. You can also find them in the Client Portal under Accounts, next to MT4 or MT5.

f8.default: Download the version that matches your account (MT4 or MT5) from the Vantage Client Portal, or get the MetaTrader app from the App Store or Google Play.

f11.default: Enter your account number and trading password, then choose the exact Vantage server shown in your portal. Type the password by hand rather than pasting it.

f14.default: Open MetaTrader, go to File → Login to Trade Account, enter your account number and password, select your Vantage server and click Login.

f17.default: In the MetaTrader app, go to Settings → New Account (or Manage Accounts → +), search for Vantage, pick your server and sign in.

f20.default: You’ll see your balance in the Trade tab and live prices moving. If it says “Invalid account”, check the server name and that MT4/MT5 matches your account.
